clauses.title: Array Objects
clauses.scope: Array elements can be objects of different types.

clauses.title: Indirect Objects
clauses.scope: Any object may be indirect, including an object referenced from an array or dictionary value.

clauses.title: Page Objects
clauses.scope: MediaBox is a rectangle; CropBox defines the visible region and clipping. No direct-only restriction is imposed on these rectangle entries.

clauses.title: Rectangles
clauses.scope: Four numeric corner coordinates define a rectangle. Numeric reference elements resolve to the same numeric objects.
Not assigned any additional unverified normative requirements

governing_legacy.validity_conclusion: Whole-array and numeric-coordinate references are permitted by the general indirect-object rule; these ordinary page-box entries impose no direct-only exception.

limits: Full2020 standard not acquired; base page-box wording is grounded in the separately inspected PDF1.7 governing edition.
Exact raster pixels on inset regions are acceptance criteria; no ISO antialiasing requirement is asserted.
